summary: Iteration 215x testing complete. Backend: 17/17 tests passed. All new course builder features working: course creation with excluded dates (school holidays), bulk enrolment, enrolment roster, un-enrol, and monthly invoice preview with multi-course grouping. Frontend: Plans tab has Plans/Courses subtabs, Courses view shows course list with detail panel, enrol dialog with multi-select, and plan editor has Skip dates picker with amber chips.
critical_code_review_comments: All 215x features implemented correctly and tested
Course excluded dates correctly skip specified dates and extend course duration
Enrolment is idempotent - re-enrolling returns bookings_created=0, bookings_skipped_already_enrolled=N*members
Invoice preview correctly groups multiple courses + ad-hoc classes into ONE invoice per member
Tz-aware datetime fix working - naive datetimes from earlier courses don't crash invoice preview
seed_data_creation: Used existing Dance Term 2026 Spring course with 2 excluded dates (2026-05-26, 2026-06-16) and 2 enrolled pupils
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 215x features all working: (1) POST /api/memberships/plans with kind='course' + course_excluded_dates creates course with materialised sessions that SKIP excluded dates and still produce course_session_count sessions, (2) POST /api/memberships/plans/{plan_id}/enrol bulk-enrols members with idempotent behavior, (3) GET /api/memberships/plans/{plan_id}/enrolments returns {sessions, enrolled, pupil_count, smoothed}, returns 400 for non-course plans, (4) DELETE /api/memberships/plans/{plan_id}/enrolments/{member_id} cancels future bookings and membership row, (5) POST /api/memberships/billing/monthly-invoice/preview groups all courses + ad-hoc classes into ONE invoice per member with no duplicates, (6) Frontend: Plans tab has Plans/Courses subtabs (data-testid='mbr-plans-tab-plans', 'mbr-plans-tab-courses'), Courses view (data-testid='mbr-courses') shows course list and detail with enrol button (data-testid='mbr-course-enrol'), enrol dialog (data-testid='mbr-course-enrol-dialog') has search and confirm button (data-testid='mbr-course-enrol-confirm'), plan editor shows course block settings with Skip dates picker (data-testid='mbr-plan-course-excluded-input') and 'Skip this date' button that adds amber chips.
